The shared appearance helper invokes movement processing before its timer test and subtracts 1.0 on the false path. Canonical Lugia code confirms saved-pointer ordering, state-1 entry and subsequent animation-controlled transition to state 2.

The complete canonical loop preserves candidate z, tests three-dimensional distance, adds 180 to persistent heading on rejection and commits only after acceptance. No retry limit, local validation or opponent lookup appears. Universal termination remains appropriately deferred.
